import 'package:adele_capabilities/adele_capabilities.dart';
import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';

import 'prepared_environment_capability_environment.dart';
import 'prepared_environment_capability_support.dart';

// Controlled A supplements the real stock A integration, reusing G1 transport,
// canonical restore and checkpoints to hold reverse calls without clock races.
Future<void> main(List<String> arguments, Object? bootstrapMessage) =>
    runProbeBackend(
      arguments,
      bootstrapMessage,
      (state) => {
        'shared': {
          environmentProviderServiceId: EnvironmentProviderServiceDispatcher(
            state.options['noBufferedFacet'] == true
                ? EnvironmentProviderServiceAdapter(_WithoutBufferedFacet())
                : _BufferedEnvironment(state),
            concurrent: true,
          ),
        },
        'buffered': {
          environmentProviderServiceId: EnvironmentProviderServiceDispatcher(
            _BufferedEnvironment(state),
            concurrent: true,
          ),
        },
      },
    );

// The actual optional-facet guard runs inside A's generated service adapter.
final class _WithoutBufferedFacet implements EnvironmentProvider {
  @override
  ProviderId get providerId => ProviderId('test.environment.a');

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentProviderResult> restore(
    LocalEnvironment environment,
  ) async =>
      EnvironmentProviderResult(providerState: environment.providerState!);

  @override
  dynamic noSuchMethod(Invocation invocation) =>
      throw StateError('No fallback Environment operations are allowed.');
}

final class _BufferedEnvironment extends EnvironmentService {
  _BufferedEnvironment(super.state);
  final _providers = <String, String>{};

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentProviderResult> restore(
    EnvironmentTransportContext environment,
  ) {
    _providers[environment.environmentId] = environment.providerId;
    return super.restore(environment);
  }

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentBufferedProcessResult> runBufferedProcess(
    String environmentId,
    EnvironmentBufferedProcessRequest request,
  ) async {
    final action = request.arguments[1].split('=').last;
    state.processes.add({
      'environmentId': environmentId,
      'providerId': _providers[environmentId],
      'program': request.program,
      'arguments': request.arguments,
      'stdinBase64': request.stdinBase64,
    });
    await state.checkpoint('process:$action');
    final failure = switch (action) {
      'timeout' => 'process_timed_out',
      'stdout-overflow' => 'process_output_overflow',
      'unavailable' => environmentBufferedProcessUnavailableCode,
      _ => null,
    };
    if (failure != null) {
      throw EnvironmentFailure(
        code: failure,
        message: 'SECRET controlled process failure',
        details: const {'outputComplete': false},
      );
    }
    return EnvironmentBufferedProcessResult(
      exitCode: action == 'nonzero' ? 17 : 0,
      stdoutBase64: action == 'empty'
          ? ''
          : encodeEnvironmentProcessBytes(
              environmentId == 'additional' ? [0, 255, 195, 40] : [0, 128, 66],
              maximumBytes: environmentBufferedProcessStdoutLimit,
            ),
      stderrBase64: action == 'nonzero' ? '/wA=' : '',
    );
  }
}
